pokemon_scp.name: Nidoqueen
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0031 is to be contained in a reinforced subterranean vault with shock‑absorbent flooring. Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 15 meters. All structural supports must be inspected weekly for stress fractures.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0031 is a large mammalian organism with dermal plating composed of mineralized keratin. Capable of generating seismic shockwaves through ground strikes. Venom secreted from its claws causes rapid tissue necrosis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Extremely protective and aggressive. Displays territorial dominance and attempts to shield SCP-0030 during perceived threats.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0031-A: SCP-0031 generated a shockwave that destabilized three support pillars.
Addendum 0031-B: Venom samples show crystalline structures similar to mineral toxins.

pokemon_scp.name: Nidoran♂
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0032 is to be kept in a toxin‑neutralizing enclosure. Personnel must avoid contact with SCP-0032’s horn.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0032 is a small mammalian organism with a venomous horn capable of delivering mild neurotoxins. Displays heightened alertness and rapid reflexes.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Skittish but curious. Shows interest in rhythmic sounds.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0032-A: SCP-0032’s venom potency increased after exposure to SCP-0033.
Addendum 0032-B: SCP-0032 produced a series of chirps resembling Morse code.

pokemon_scp.name: Nidorino
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0033 is to be contained in a reinforced mammalian chamber with toxin‑resistant barriers. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0033’s charge behavior.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0033 possesses a hardened horn capable of penetrating steel. Venom causes severe muscle spasms and temporary blindness.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and territorial. Frequently charges at perceived threats.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0033-A: SCP-0033 shattered a reinforced barrier during a charge.
Addendum 0033-B: Venom samples show rapid mutation under stress.

pokemon_scp.name: Nidoking
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0034 is to be contained in a titan‑class reinforced vault with seismic dampeners. Personnel must not enter without full hazard gear. All structural supports must be reinforced with tungsten alloy.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0034 is a massive mammalian organism with dermal plating and a horn capable of delivering catastrophic venom. Displays immense physical strength and can generate localized earthquakes.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly aggressive. Shows strategic awareness and targets structural weak points.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0034-A: SCP-0034 breached containment by collapsing a support pillar.
Addendum 0034-B: Venom samples show corrosive properties capable of dissolving titanium.

pokemon_scp.name: Clefairy
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0035 is to be contained in a lunar‑simulation chamber with low‑gravity fields. Personnel may interact with SCP-0035 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0035 displays mild reality‑altering properties, including levitation and low‑level spatial distortion. Emits soft luminescent pulses correlated with lunar phases.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly and curious. Shows fascination with reflective surfaces.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0035-A: SCP-0035 levitated a researcher’s clipboard for several minutes.
Addendum 0035-B: Luminescent pulses intensified during a full moon.

pokemon_scp.name: Clefable
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0036 is not to be contained forcibly. SCP-0036 cooperates with Foundation personnel and may be summoned via harmonic resonance protocols.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0036 exhibits advanced spatial manipulation abilities, including short‑range teleportation and dimensional phasing. Capable of neutralizing minor anomalies through harmonic interference.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm and benevolent. Shows protective behavior toward SCP-0035.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0036-A: SCP-0036 neutralized a Class‑II spatial anomaly during testing.
Addendum 0036-B: SCP-0036 phased through a containment wall without causing structural damage.

pokemon_scp.name: Vulpix
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0037 is to be housed in a fire‑resistant enclosure with temperature control. Personnel may interact with SCP-0037 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0037 is a small fox‑like organism capable of producing controlled fireballs. Tail count correlates with thermal output.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful and affectionate. Uses fireballs to communicate excitement.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0037-A: SCP-0037 produced a fireball shaped like a spiral.
Addendum 0037-B: Tail samples show anomalous heat retention.

pokemon_scp.name: Ninetales
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0038 is to be contained in a heat‑shielded chamber with flame‑dampening systems. Personnel must avoid eye contact with SCP-0038.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0038 is a fox‑like organism with nine tails, each capable of generating intense flames. Eye contact induces hypnotic effects and long‑term psychological influence.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but manipulative. Displays intelligence comparable to humans.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0038-A: A researcher exposed to SCP-0038’s gaze reported hearing whispered commands.
Addendum 0038-B: SCP-0038 melted a reinforced barrier during a rage event.

pokemon_scp.name: Jigglypuff
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0039 is to be contained in a sound‑dampened chamber. Personnel must wear auditory protection during interaction.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0039 emits a melodic song that induces sleep in all nearby organisms. Acoustic analysis reveals subliminal frequencies affecting neural activity.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly but easily frustrated when ignored. Attempts to draw attention before singing.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0039-A: SCP-0039’s song incapacitated an entire security team.
Addendum 0039-B: Sleep induced by SCP-0039 shows unusually vivid dream activity.

pokemon_scp.name: Wigglytuff
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0040 is to be contained in a reinforced elastic chamber. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0040’s inflation response.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0040 can inflate its body to several times its normal size, generating shockwaves capable of damaging structures. Skin elasticity exceeds known biological limits.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Generally calm but becomes aggressive when startled.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0040-A: SCP-0040’s inflation shockwave shattered nearby equipment.
Addendum 0040-B: Skin samples show anomalous regenerative properties.
